name: UGC 3476 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3476, a nearby galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3476-hubble
story: UGC 3476 is one of the nearby galaxies Hubble visited in a push to observe every known galaxy close to home. The brightness of its brightest red giant stars tells astronomers how far away it is.

claims.text: UGC 3476 is a target of the 'Every Known Nearby Galaxy' program
The program aims at a complete sample of suspected nearby galaxies
Distances come from the tip of the red giant branch
